sources.why: Gas generator buying guide; excerpt doesn't cover battery alternatives
Portable vs standby gas generators, not quiet alternatives
Extension guide naming battery backup options and safety
Store guide comparing power stations and generators, general only
Affiliate explainer from a site with many near-duplicate pages, no testing
Comparison table with output, noise and runtime ranges
Spec-verified solar vs gas cost and safety comparison, no lab tests
Generic comparison with no data of its own
AP news article quoting experts on battery vs generator

missing: Lab-tested picks of specific power station models, with measured noise levels (dB), usable capacity and real runtimes on a fridge or CPAP, plus how they compare with quiet inverter gas generators.
why: Several sources point to a portable power station or solar generator as the quiet alternative. WVU Extension and AP give the safety and use-case picture, and Tested Watts and Roof & Router add spec ranges. AP isn't a standards body, but I counted it as an authority because it's established news reporting that quotes experts, and that is a judgment call. Even so, no major reviewer here tests power stations or measures noise. The Consumer Reports pages only cover gas generators, and much of the rest is recycled affiliate content.
